sources.why: Needs a free data.gov.in API key and an Indian network: api.data.gov.in does not accept connections from this machine. Until then India's column uses a private website for vegetables, NCDEX exchange prices for grains, pulses, oils and spices, and FAO's monthly Delhi wholesale series (Department of Consumer Affairs).

sources.market: Delhi, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, Gujarat (vegetables)
sources.why: PRIVATE website, method not published; its prices look closer to retail than mandi wholesale. Use it for direction, not exact levels. It is India's column for vegetables only until the official data.gov.in feed works.

sources.market: NCDEX spot poll and front-month futures
sources.unit: Rs per quintal (oils Rs per 10 kg, pepper Rs per kg)
sources.why: Exchange prices, not mandi prices: NCDEX's own polled spot at its delivery centres (Unjha jeera, Nizamabad turmeric, Delhi chana ...) and the front futures settlement. They stand in for India where no mandi price is on file.

sources.source: Agmarknet via Ashoka University CEDA (official data)
sources.unit: Rs per quintal, per kg here
sources.why: Official Agmarknet mandi data, cleaned by Ashoka University's CEDA. It ends about a year behind (latest month 2025-10), so it gives India's price in the same month last year, never today's gap.
Daily wholesale prices published by the market itself.
Daily wholesale prices published by the market itself.
An index of China's wholesale prices (2015 = 100), not a price per kg; shown as context only.

sources.unit: yen per package, per kg here
sources.why: Real wholesale prices, but the city publishes them months late (latest day on file: 2026-06-30). Shown for scale only; never compared with today's Indian price.

sources.country: India, China, Bangladesh, Saudi Arabia, USA, Germany, Netherlands
sources.market: Delhi wholesale (Dept. of Consumer Affairs), national averages, New York
sources.unit: local currency per kg (converted from the series unit)
sources.why: UN FAO collects official national price series: Delhi wholesale from India's Department of Consumer Affairs (monthly), China, Bangladesh, Germany and Netherlands national wholesale averages, New York wholesale fruit, and Saudi Arabia RETAIL prices (the nearest Gulf data: FAO has no UAE series). Weekly series are dated by week, monthly by the 1st.

sources.market: World reference prices (oils, rice, wheat, maize, sugar, banana)
sources.unit: USD per tonne or per kg
sources.why: World benchmark prices (export or import quotes such as Malaysian palm oil or Thai 5% rice), monthly averages. A reference for traded bulk goods, not a mandi price.

sources.unit: USD per package, per kg where the weight is stated
sources.why: Needs a free USDA MARS API key (DESK_USDA_KEY or data/keys.json). Nothing is shown for the USA until one is added.

sources.market: Dubai Al Aweer central fruit and vegetable market
sources.why: No free daily public price feed was found. Dubai Municipality and the UAE statistics centre publish retail price indices and occasional reports, not a daily wholesale price list a program can read, and FAO's price database (FPMA) has no UAE series. Saudi Arabia's national retail prices (FAO) are shown as the nearest Gulf data.

sources.market: Dutch wholesale and auction markets (fruit and vegetables)
sources.why: No free daily public price list was found. The EU agri-food data portal publishes weekly averages for a few products with a lag; Dutch auction (veiling) prices are for members. Only eggs come through FAO (monthly).

sources.market: German wholesale markets (Grossmarkt, fruit and vegetables)
sources.why: No free daily public price list was found. Wholesale market reports (BLE, AMI) are weekly, paid, or not machine-readable. Only wheat and eggs come through FAO (monthly).

notes: A price gap is not a profit. Moving goods between countries costs freight, insurance, import duty, cold storage, packing, losses on the way and paperwork, and some exports are banned or capped. Grade and variety differ too.
Prices are wholesale, in each market's own unit, converted to rupees per kg at that day's exchange rate.

India's column is the first available of: Delhi mandi (data.gov.in), all-India mandi median, Delhi on vegetablemarketprice.com (a private site), NCDEX spot poll, NCDEX futures, Delhi wholesale from the Department of Consumer Affairs (monthly, via FAO). NCDEX prices are exchange prices, not mandi prices.
